cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Affectionate Resentment
cards.instruction: Remain warm and familiar while letting old resentment sharpen beneath every caring gesture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Here's your tea, love. Exactly right, even without a birthday reminder.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've brought cake. A month late, I know.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Your favourite, too. I'll warm your plate; I've kept the candle ready.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Put it in. I'll sing now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come closer, love. I'll shield the flame. We don't want it stopping halfway through like last year's birthday call.

mechanism: A warmly grants late celebration arrangements while using each granted comfort to sharpen the history of neglected birthdays.
confusable: D69 warm control narrows choice; D93 specifically lets old resentment remain under each caring gesture.
comparison: Late cake and a protected candle differ from warming a partner after a taxi wait.
seedUse: Use D93-a correctly made tea, month-late cake and interrupted old call; remove the cold stock reprimand but retain pointed familiarity.
